title: svc auto-learning-candidate
description: Entry in `.svc/auto-learnings.jsonl` produced by `hooks/svc-auto-capture-learnings.mjs` per WI-343. Audit-log entries; tracked-file promotion happens via `scripts/promote-auto-learnings.mjs` only. Schema baselined 2026-05-12 by WI-343 tranche 1.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the hook detected the candidate.

signal.description: Which of the 6 heuristics from the proposal detected this candidate.

key.description: Kebab-case slug for dedup. Should be unique-ish but content-derived; dedup compares key + insight prefix.

insight.description: Free-form one-paragraph insight, conforming to the existing learnings.jsonl `insight` field.

confidence.description: Heuristic confidence 1-10. Dedup skips append when an existing entry has >= confidence.

source.description: Citation: PR number, commit SHA, decision-log entry, or hook event identifier.

session_id.description: Branch name + short hash + ts; identifies the session that captured this candidate. Used to suppress duplicate same-session captures.

candidate_target.description: Suggested promotion target if/when promoted. Classifier output; final destination decided at promotion time.

files.description: File paths cited in the insight.

trigger.description: Which trigger surface produced this candidate. Set by `hooks/svc-auto-capture-learnings.mjs` from the `--trigger` argv (host hooks: `stop`, `pre-compact`, `post-tool-use`) OR by `scripts/capture-session-learnings.mjs` (`manual-cli`). Falls back to `unknown` when the wrapper omits it. Tranche 1 wires `stop`, `pre-compact`, and `post-tool-use` on Claude Code; tranche 2c added the `manual-cli` standalone path; other hosts add their own per `provision/hosts/<host>.json` in tranche 2+.
